<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->

## Findings
- Project root IS the sympy checkout (c935e1d106, ~Mar 2018, just before upstream PR #13852). The venv's site-packages sympy 1.14 is NOT what `import sympy` picks up from the root (cwd wins); 1.14 serves only as a post-fix reference.
- Issue #4033 has two parts, both fixed upstream in PR #13852 (sympy/functions/special/zeta_functions.py):
  1. `polylog(2, 1/2)` unevaluated -> fixed by a dilog table lookup in `polylog.eval` for s==2 (keys: 1/2, 2, golden-ratio related, ±I, 1±I, (1±I)/2).
  2. `expand_func(polylog(1, z))` = `-log(1 + exp_polar(-I*pi)*z)` -> should be `-log(1 - z)` (same branch: mpmath Im = -pi for real z>1 in both; derivative consistency restored).
- Baseline: sympy/functions/special/tests/test_zeta_functions.py 10 passed (pre-fix). Tests must NOT be modified; old test line 131 still passes with `-log(1 - z)` via myexpand's numeric fallback.

## Decisions
- Minimal fix, mirroring upstream: (1) `_eval_expand_func` s==1 -> `-log(1 - z)`; (2) docstring example updated to match; (3) `_dilogtable()` + s==2 lookup appended to `polylog.eval`. No test changes, no commit.
